sloka: उवाच लक्ष्मणम् वीरो दुःखितो दुःखितम् वचः ।अभिजानामि पुष्पाणि तानि इमानि इह लक्ष्मण ॥३-६४-२६॥
transliteration: uvāca lakṣmaṇam vīro duḥkhito duḥkhitam vacaḥ ।abhijānāmi puṣpāṇi tāni imāni iha lakṣmaṇa ॥3-64-26॥

translations.english: O Lakshmana, here are the same flowers I had given Vaidehi to wear in the forest. I can recognize them.
